units.cer: ratio; multiply by100 for percent display

metric_definitions.cer: Total Levenshtein character edits divided by total normalized reference characters; not average clipCER.
metric_definitions.wer: Total word edits divided by total normalized reference words; diagnostic, not final goal threshold.
metric_definitions.cosine: Average recording similarity within speaker, then average speakers; not a percentage of identity or human listening score.
metric_definitions.normalization: Pinned scoring normalization uses Unicode NFC, casefold, punctuation removal and collapsed spaces; CER includes normalized spaces.
metric_definitions.goal: Complete original114; both groups independently CER<0.03 and cosine>0.984, no truncations, complete native/artifact audit and successful owning process closure.
metric_definitions.missing: null means not supplied/measured in this dataset. Never draw as0.
